objective: Wire ReportWorkerPool into the FastAPI lifespan in app/main.py and implement startup recovery (requeue stale running rows, resume retry_wait schedules) satisfying contracts C3/C4/C5, with lifecycle tests

allowed_dependencies.what: JobStore implementation and report_jobs model (imported for recovery queries)

non_goals: Do not touch app/api/** or app/db/models.py (T01 owns the model)
Do not add a distributed lock or multi-instance coordination (assumption A-1)
Do not change the worker pool internals (T02 owns report_worker.py)
implementation_constraints: Lifespan ordering is load-bearing: run recovery BEFORE pool.start(), and pool.stop() on shutdown
Recovery must be idempotent — running a second startup pass with no stale rows is a no-op
Requeue uses JobStore.transition(running -> queued) so C3 legality still applies

deliverables.what: lifespan wiring (recovery then pool start; pool stop on shutdown)

acceptance_tests.description: on app startup, rows with status 'running' are re-queued: after lifespan startup each such row has status 'queued' and its recompute is scheduled
on app startup, rows with status 'retry_wait' resume: next run scheduled per C3 backoff, no immediate run if backoff not elapsed
acceptance_tests.evidence: pytest tests/test_startup_recovery.py::test_startup_resumes_retry_wait asserts the schedule and no premature run

acceptance_tests.description: startup with no stale rows: recovery is a no-op — the pool starts and the row count is unchanged
acceptance_tests.evidence: pytest tests/test_startup_recovery.py::test_startup_no_stale_noop asserts row count unchanged and pool started

acceptance_tests.description: shutdown: after lifespan exit, pool.stop() has run and no worker threads are active

failure_cases.scenario: a row transitions while recovery is scanning
failure_cases.expected_behavior: guarded by the transition check — a test asserts a second recovery pass finds no stale rows (idempotent)

failure_cases.scenario: recovery runs after pool.start() by accident (ordering regression)
failure_cases.expected_behavior: a test asserting lifespan ordering fails — ordering is enforced, not assumed

handoff.notes: Record the exact lifespan ordering and the stale predicate in verified_facts — gate E2 depends on recovery-before-start semantics

warnings.detail: p80 upper bound (110 min) exceeds the Stage budget leaf_p80_max (90 min)
warnings.rationale: recovery edge cases (stale detection, retry_wait reschedule, restart ordering) are the uncertainty source; checkpoint at the 'lifespan wiring done' subgoal regardless
